blocks.title: Mil kar masail hal karna
blocks.text: Collaborative problem solving ka matlab doosron ke saath mil kar challenges hal karna aur mushtarak maqasid tak pohanchna hai.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein tawun ki do qismein bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Insaan aur machine ka tawun, aur teamwork aur ilm ki sharing.

items: Tawun: insaan machines ke saath, aur insaan insaan ke saath.
